title: Dicee Challenge Step 3 - Create a Random Number
section: 17. Boss Level Challenge 1 - The Dicee Game
summary: Step 3: in the script, create randomNumber1 holding a random whole number from 1 to 6 and verify it in the console.

concepts.heading: Random integer from 1 to 6
points: Math.random() returns a decimal from 0 up to but not including 1.
Multiply by 6 to get 0 up to (not including) 6.
Math.floor rounds down to a whole number, giving 0-5.
Add 1 to shift the range to 1-6.
Store the result in a variable named randomNumber1 and run it repeatedly to check the range.

task.goal: A variable with a random value 1-6.
steps: Log it and refresh several times to see values vary.

pitfalls: Using Math.round, which skews the odds of 1 and 6.
Writing Math.random() * 6 + 1 without floor, giving decimals.
